## Active

### D-103 — blong-graph adoption of the introspection API is blocked on its dispatch

> _2026-09-12 · tools/blong-graph · active_

`tools/blong-graph/server.ts` wires `children: ['./adapter', './gateway']` when no `gateway/`
exists, and a `graphDispatch` config with no orchestrator file to consume it, so its handler never
sees a registry. Adopting `Registry.describe()` therefore means building the missing dispatch
orchestrator first — a package-sized job rather than a one-line swap, so it stayed out of the kukum
change set.
